description.content:
Creates a request for proposal (RFP). Returns a unique RFP ID for a successful request.
***Note:*** Subscribers can create RFPs [using the API](/guides/proposals/create-and-manage-RFPs/#create-an-rfp) or via [Service Automation](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/560300086/Creating+an+RFP).
**Example Request** POST /rfps { "Number": "", "PONumber": "", "WONumber": "", "TradeId": 90480, "Description": "New doors for the office", "Date": "", "DueHrs": 48, "DueDate": "", "Location": { "Id": 2006071467, "StoreId": "" }, "ProviderId": 2000090505, "ResponseDate": "", "ProposalNotificationEmail": "LFAlways1776@gmail.com", "ProviderEmail": "", "ProposalTemplateId": 0, "WorkOrderId": 0, "ProjectId": 0 }

response.name: The RFP is created, and a unique RFP ID is returned in the response.

item.name: Assign an RFP to another provider

request.name: Assign an RFP to another provider

description.content:
Assigns the RFP to the specified provider. Returns a unique RFP ID for a successful request.
***Note:*** The provider you want to assign the RFP to should have access to the location and trade for which the RFP was created.
Learn more about [assigning an RFP to another provider](/guides/proposals/create-and-manage-RFPs/#assign-an-rfp-to-another-provider).
**Example Request** PUT /rfps/{rfpId}/assign { "ProviderId": 2000090505, "ProviderEmail": "" }

variable.description: (Required) The unique numeric identifier of the RFP to assign to the specified provider.

response.name: The RFP is assigned to the specified provider, and a unique RFP ID is returned in the response.

item.name: Delete an RFP by the RFP number and location ID

request.name: Delete an RFP by the RFP number and location ID

description.content:
Permanently deletes the RFP by the specified RFP number and location ID. It cannot be undone.
***Note:*** The RFP number is not unique. If multiple RFPs with the same number were created for a location, all of them are deleted when you pass the request.
Learn more about [deleting RFPs via the API](/guides/proposals/create-and-manage-RFPs/#delete-an-rfp).
